page_title: Secure Internal search for high performance teams

sources.entry: Selectric - Private search across email, documents, and chat apps.

summary.name: Selectric
summary.one_liner: Selectric is a private, AI-powered personal search tool that indexes your email, cloud drives and chat apps locally so you can search them from any app on your Mac.
use_cases: Finding past emails, invoices and payment confirmations
Locating the latest version of shared presentations or documents
Searching across Slack, Teams and cloud drives without pinging colleagues
Drafting factually grounded email replies from internal data
Quickly finding the canonical source of truth in team documents
summary.what_it_does: Selectric builds a personal search index for each user from only the data that user can access, covering mail, shared cloud drives and chat channels such as Gmail, Outlook, Google Drive, OneDrive, Slack, Teams, Dropbox and Box. Searches are triggered with a keyboard shortcut (Cmd+Shift+K) from inside any app. The page says indexing and searches run locally on the device, and that the tool keeps watching connected sources for new content. It also has automation features, such as generating email replies grounded in the user's own data, and it claims to work well with large inboxes. The page says initial indexing takes about 15 minutes and that 10,000 emails and documents use under 250MB.
notable: Per-user local index built only from data the user can access
Keyboard shortcut search (Cmd+Shift+K) from any app
Generates email replies grounded in internal data
Connectors for Gmail, Outlook, Google Drive, OneDrive, Slack, Teams, Dropbox and Box
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later; Apple Silicon recommended
Corporate accounts may need IT department to grant access
Pro version has paid features; details are on the separate Pricing page and were not shown here
